text_block_list.text:
During lunch break, when I came to the 
cafeteria—

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Ah, familiar~! You come over here too! 
I'll show you something good♪

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Ta-daaa, it's my treasure! Well, aren't 
you jealous~♪

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
I know, right~? It's so fluffy, and the 
ribbon around its neck looks adorable on 
it too♪

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
My mom put this ribbon on for me♪ And all 
the other parts were handmade by my 
grandma, you know.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
That's right! When Mom was little, Grandma 
made it for her, wishing for her to 'grow 
up big and strong.'

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
And when I reached about the same age, Mom 
tied a ribbon around it and passed it down 
to me.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Grandma was taking care of it, so it's 
been staying home lately, but from now on, 
we can be together all the time♪

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
A plushie passed down through 
generations!! That's sooo wonderful! I 
love things like that!
However, a few days later—

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Waaaahaaa~n!! You stupid, stupid, stupid 
crow~~!!
choice_data_list: What happened!? You're covered in mud!
What happened?! You're covered in mud!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Noooo... Why...!? Uwaaah, my precious 
babyyy~!

Looking at my hands, the arm of the 
plushie she showed me the other day had 
been torn off and gone missing.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Oh no!! It's completely ruined... 
*sniff*... Waaah!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Familiar! Do something... Do something 
about this!!
choice_data_list: ...Don't cry, I promise I'll fix it.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Really!? Really, really? It's a promise!! 
You'd better keep it, okay?!

I return to the trainer's office and 
immediately attempt repairs. I have almost 
no knowledge of this, but I have no choice 
but to try.

I managed to patch up everything except 
what was missing, but unless I can do 
something about that all-important arm...

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
You're almost there! Keep hanging in 
there!!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Excuse me~. There was something I wanted 
to ask about regarding the joint 
training~—

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
! Isn't that the plushie you showed me 
before? What happened to it!?
I explained the situation to Rhein Kraft.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
If that's the case... Please let me help 
too!! I'm actually quite good at sewing.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Please don't worry about it!! I know just 
how precious that plushie is to you, 
Sweep-san!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Craft...

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Then I'll cheer you on with magic too! 
Lots and lots of it...!!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Grandma always said that if you truly 
believe from the bottom of your heart, 
it'll definitely come true!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
! Yes! With your magic imbued into it, 
Sweep-san, it'll be so reassuring!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Freesia, Viburnum, Echinacea! Change right 
back to normal, please-a!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Phew... I somehow managed to do it.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Amazing, amazing! Thank you... Craft.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Familiar... You too!
choice_data_list: It's all thanks to both of your hard work.
I feel like I wasn't of much help...

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Well... I suppose that's true. Sweepy's 
spell and Craft's healing magic were both 
amazing after all♪
choice_data_list: Maybe you should learn some healing magic?

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
If you want, I can teach you anytime~ Just 
leave it all to me!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
"So Magical Girl Sweepy will acquire the 
power of healing as a new spell, huh?"

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Heheh, I'm gonna master it in no time 
flat!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Hmph, it's true! If Craft hadn't come, my 
arm might never have gotten better!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
All you did was clean up the other spots, 
and—

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
"Just that... you came to help me when I 
needed it most!"

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
So, just a little bit... Just a tiny 
little bit, I'll give you some praise.
